d: A big arcade cabinet with its own screen and two joysticks. Right-click it to play Flash/Newgrounds games, web games or your own ROMs; a friend can join as player 2. It also works as a Smart TV.
A big arcade cabinet with its own screen and two joysticks. Right-click it to play Flash/Newgrounds games, web games or your own ROMs; a friend can join as player 2. It also works as a Smart TV.
Right-click to switch it on: it plugs into the nearest Smart TV. Then right-click that TV to play Newgrounds/Flash games or your own retro ROMs, with everyone nearby watching.

A treasure-chest mimic that is secretly a game console. Right-click to switch it on, like any console. Right-click it while holding a chiseled block and it disguises itself as that block, name and all (the chiseled block isn't used up). Pick it up and place it again to undo the disguise.
Right-click to switch it on: it plugs into the nearest Smart TV. Then right-click that TV to play Newgrounds/Flash games or your own retro ROMs, with everyone nearby watching.
